info.title: SYNTHORA Open Interest Oracle
info.description: Live perpetual-futures open interest, funding rates, mark price, premium and crowded long/short signal for 230+ assets, sourced from Hyperliquid. Ed25519-signed. Pay-per-use via x402 USDC on Base.
info.x-guidance: POST /service with {"asset":"BTC"} for one asset, or empty {} for the top market by open interest.

monitor perp funding rates across the market

find funding-rate arbitrage opportunities
